stations.title: Last week's code
stations.text: Works only for the values at the top.

captions: Monday at the base. Ailsa had four teams on the radio on Saturday night.
Today the code works only for the values at the top, so she edits it between calls.
You write functions that take any call sign, crew or radio and give an answer back.
Now every team's call goes through the same functions and into the log.
def, parameters, return, and functions that call each other.
